description: List currently offered travel eSIM destinations (countries and multi-country regions) with their localized names, identifiers and starting EUR prices. Use when the travel destination is unknown or to discover valid destinations before search_plans; filter type=country or type=region, or omit it for both. Results are informational only and do not reserve inventory or prices.

lang.description: Language for names and texts (default en).
